reason: An authentication gate for DeepSeek Harness web deployments that protects browser, API, and WebSocket access, supports password or token login, manages sessions, rate-limits attempts, and includes a user-management CLI.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页部署提供登录保护、会话管理、登录限速以及用户管理命令行工具。
summaries.en: Adds login protection, session management, rate limiting, and a user-management CLI to DeepSeek Harness web deployments.

capabilities: Protects web pages, API calls, and WebSocket connections with login checks
Manages sessions with cookies and configurable expiration
Provides a CLI for adding, listing, and disabling users
Applies login rate limiting and temporary lockouts
